summary: Final report MV-2015-266 for Selverant: IKr inhibition, Five-isoform DDI screen on 38 compounds (Aminoquinazoline). Study summary (benchmark) table on page 1; full compound tables, methods and control results follow.

title_block.title: ST03 growth-signal programme: rapid hERG/DDI screen of 38 compounds
title_block.subtitle: Final Report

blocks.p: 38 compounds from the Selverant aminoquinazoline series 03 were tested for Selverant in the IKr inhibition, Five-isoform DDI screen. Testing started on December 8, 2015 and results were reported on December 28, 2015. All runs met matrix acceptance criteria. 1 of 38 compounds had an IC50 below 1 µM and should be treated as a clear liability. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C19.
To rank the test article set for IKr inhibition, Five-isoform DDI screen liability so that Selverant could choose analogues for progression.
38 compounds were received as 10 mM DMSO solutions in one accession lot on December 8, 2015 and logged against M15/BIO/06146. Identity and concentration were taken as supplied by the client.

CHO cells stably expressing hERG (KCNH2) were recorded in whole-cell configuration on a 16-channel automated patch clamp platform at room temperature. Cells were held at -80 mV, depolarised to +40 mV for 2 s and repolarised to -50 mV for 2 s to elicit the tail current, at 0.1 Hz. Each compound was applied cumulatively at 0.12, 0.37, 1.1, 3.3, 10 and 30 µM (0.3% DMSO final), with 3-5 minutes per concentration.

list: Matrix acceptance: seal resistance ≥500 MΩ before break-in and ≥200 MΩ throughout
Tail current amplitude ≥200 pA at baseline; run-down ≤10% over the vehicle period
Positive control E-4031 on every run; IC50 must fall within 5-50 nM
IC50 from a four-parameter logistic fit of mean tail-current inhibition; n≥2 cells per compound

blocks.p: Pooled human liver microsomes (0.1 mg/mL protein) were incubated with each compound at 10 µM and an isoform-selective probe substrate at approximately Km, in duplicate, for 10 minutes at 37 °C after NADPH addition. Metabolite formation was measured by LC-MS/MS against vehicle (0.1% DMSO) incubations.
Results are reported as mean percent inhibition relative to vehicle. Values above 50% at 10 µM are flagged for follow-up; small negative values indicate no inhibition.

All {{PRJ0003:herg.n_tested}} compounds were tested. 1 of 38 compounds had an IC50 below 1 µM and should be treated as a clear liability. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. The median IC50 was {{PRJ0003:herg.median_ic50_uM}} µM ({{PRJ0003:herg.n_lt_1uM}} below 1 µM, {{PRJ0003:herg.n_1_10uM}} between 1 and 10 µM, {{PRJ0003:herg.n_ge_10uM}} at or above 10 µM). E-4031 gave an IC50 of {{PRJ0003:herg.control_e4031_nM}} nM, within the acceptance range.

Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C19. In total {{PRJ0003:cyp.n_any_gt50}} compounds inhibited at least one isoform by more than 50% at 10 µM (CYP3A4: {{PRJ0003:cyp.n_gt50_CYP3A4}}; CYP2D6: {{PRJ0003:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2D6}}; CYP2C19: {{PRJ0003:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C19}}; CYP2C9: {{PRJ0003:cyp.n_gt50_CYP2C9}}; CYP1A2: {{PRJ0003:cyp.n_gt50_CYP1A2}}). Ketoconazole inhibited CYP3A4 with an IC50 of {{PRJ0003:cyp.control_CYP3A4_uM}} µM.

1 of 38 compounds had an IC50 below 1 µM and should be treated as a clear liability. Most of the set fell in the 1-10 µM band, so the margin will depend on free therapeutic exposure. Inhibition above 50% at 10 µM was most frequent for CYP2C19. Inhibition values are in vitro, at a fixed concentration, and do not by themselves predict clinical interaction risk; free exposure estimates are needed for that assessment.
The data support ranking within the set. Recommended next step: carry the compounds without CYP flags into exposure studies and run CYP3A4 IC50s for flagged analogues before in vivo work.
